سَوَّآءٌ لَوَّآءٌ , each of the measure فَعَّالٌ, irregularly derived from اِسْتَوَى and اِلْتَوَى; a prov., applied to women, meaning Straight and bending, and collecting together and separating; not remaining in one state, or condition. (Meyd.) ―
-b2- And أَرْضٌ سَوَّآءٌ Land of which the earth, or dust, is like sand. (IAth, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
